title: Show generated comparisons one at a time
statement: When a model generates the video, show a comparison as consecutive shots or a swap in place, not as two objects side by side in one frame.
example: The first script round of one science course found 11 side-by-side or left-right requests and reworded them as sequential reveals before rendering.
detail: The grade-7 science script rules hold that video models cannot reliably render two elements side by side in one frame or honour left and right placement, so a comparison is sequenced across beats, swapped in place or shown one item at a time, with no left or right wording in the narration either (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/script-generation-v0.1.md`, line 82). The first script round found 11 such requests, which were reworded to sequential reveals before any video was generated (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/script-qc-evidence-v0.1.md`, lines 106-107 and 222). The renderability claim is asserted rather than measured: the 11 were script requests caught before rendering, not observed render failures.
against: The same course's generation specs allow a deliberate side-by-side when telling two things apart is the learner's task (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/video-generation-agent-v0.2.md`, line 48; `grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/video-generation-human-v0.2.md`, line 179), and its visual design guide recomposes a plant-versus-animal cell comparison into one frame, one cell above the other (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/video-visuals-human-v0.1.md`, lines 234-235). The record on contrast pictures, which keeps framing and scale identical in both halves, assumes both states appear together.

evidence.quote: Video models cannot reliably render two elements side-by-side in one frame or honor left/right placement.
Round-0 finding: 11 side-by-side / left-right offenders; video models can't render two-in-one-frame reliably.
**11 side-by-side / left-right offenders** were reworded to sequential reveals.
side-by-side allowed ONLY when discrimination is the learner op.
Deliberate side-by-side comparison is allowed when discrimination is the learner operation.
Recompose a wide plant-versus-animal diagram vertically: plant cell above, animal cell below, both within the 9:16 safe area.
